{"consolidated_memory":"Plan drift in infra/terraform/vpc.tf VPC module — two separate incidents:

**Incident 1 [2026-03-10]**
- Component: infra/terraform/vpc.tf (infrastructure side)
- Problem: Plan drift in VPC module; signal was a diff on a resource nobody edited
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Repro: run plan twice with no changes in between
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #1293 on branch fix/plan-drift-1
- Outcome: job finished in 15 minutes instead of 3 hours

**Incident 2 [2026-09-01]**
- Component: infra/terraform/vpc.tf (infrastructure side)
- Problem: Plan drift in VPC module; signal was a diff on a resource nobody edited
- Trigger: empty input list
- Repro: run plan twice with no changes in between
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #3242 on branch fix/plan-drift-2
- Outcome: flaky test went from 20 failures per hundred runs to zero
- Stack: HCL; covering check is the terraform plan check in CI"}
